explicitlyNotSubstituted.qbContinuityDiff: QB continuity is participation stability, not injury status: the most-recent-game primary passer's share of team pass attempts across the last three completed games. Official starter/injury evidence is a separate availability overlay and cannot silently rewrite this feature.
explicitlyNotSubstituted.windMph: Realized/reanalysis weather is not substituted for the forecast available at decision time.
explicitlyNotSubstituted.epaDiff: For the active BR2 cohort, epaDiff uses the prospectively archived SportsDataverse/cfbfastR weekly opponent-adjusted EPA source fixed by the cohort contract. CFBD WEPA remains independently monitored and is never mixed row-by-row. PPA is never relabeled as EPA.
explicitlyNotSubstituted.linePlayDiff: No subjective offensive-line grade is substituted; the registered feature is net CFBD line yards.
explicitlyNotSubstituted.travelMilesDiff: No guessed itinerary is substituted; the registered feature is great-circle program-home-location to venue miles.

activationRule: No BR2 model fit until a separately frozen feature contract has adequate point-in-time coverage and a future chronological holdout is reserved.
futureFitPrerequisites: Feature contract frozen before the evaluation cohort outcomes are observed.
Every modeled feature has timestamp-clean source lineage or remains explicitly missing.
Raw source payloads are preserved by content hash and replayable.
Multiple independent prospective week snapshots exist.
A future chronological holdout is reserved before hyperparameter selection.
No Week 5 S04_ES2 signal, threshold, stake, or delivery rule is changed.
A cohort may use only one registered EPA provider definition; provider mixing inside a cohort is prohibited.

featureCollectionDefinitions.epaDiff: home minus away net opponent-adjusted EPA per play from the cohort-fixed SportsDataverse/cfbfastR weekly team-summary snapshot; team net = adj_off_epa - adj_def_epa
featureCollectionDefinitions.linePlayDiff: home minus away net line yards; team net = offense.lineYards - defense.lineYards
featureCollectionDefinitions.travelMilesDiff: home minus away great-circle miles from registered CFBD team location to registered game venue
featureCollectionDefinitions.windMph: Open-Meteo 10m sustained wind nearest kickoff from the pregame forecast snapshot; confirmed dome = 0 with audit flag
featureCollectionDefinitions.qbContinuityDiff: home minus away prior-three-game pass-attempt share owned by each team's primary passer from its most recent completed game; ties or missing participation fail closed

shadowContracts.decisionTime: timezone-aware UTC instant; featureAsOf <= decisionTime < kickoff
shadowContracts.canonicalGameId: cfbd:<immutable provider game id>; external crosswalks require explicit evidence

week5Compatibility: Week 5 artifacts remain immutable under collection-2; collection-3 applies prospectively to later BR2 cohorts only.
